name: Costa Vida Grilled Chicken Tacos on Warm Corn Tortillas
brandOrRestaurant: Costa Vida Fresh Mexican Grill (Utah County / Salt Lake)
whyItWorks: Marinated, fire-grilled chicken breast served in soft warm corn tortillas without beans, sour cream, or fried shells. Clean, low-residue Mexican food.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order grilled chicken tacos on corn tortillas with chicken only. Skip beans, cheese, pico, and lettuce. Pair with white rice.
